capabilities: Browse a folder's images and videos as a scrollable masonry board
Attach caption notes to pins via sidecar Markdown files
Add media by dragging files in or pasting from the clipboard
Open pins full-size and flip through the board with arrow keys
Move or delete pins and their caption notes from a context menu
disambiguation: Not a canvas or moodboard editor; it only displays folder media as a read-and-caption feed, with no freeform arrangement.
extras: Manual installation only (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css into .obsidian/plugins); the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse a folder's images and videos as a visual scrolling gallery; you must open files one by one or lay them out manually.

relations.evidence: Or just click a folder in the file explorer (or Notebook Navigator) and the open board switches to it automatically.

summary: Masonry-style board view that shows all images and short videos in a chosen folder as a vertical scrolling feed with optional caption notes.
